source_text: In high-HIV contexts, early infant circumcision aligns with public health modeling showing superior lifetime risk reduction—up to 20.9% in vulnerable populations—due to procedural safety and scalability, outweighing autonomy gains from postponement, particularly given consistent findings of no adverse impacts on adult sexual function or sensitivity. [69] [44]
